The stage reference is the reference level the sensor will use to calculate the stage level during operation. To have a coherent stage level, the stage reference must be set once the sensor is installed. It can be done either with or without liquid.
If done with liquid, the stage reference will be set to the height or level of liquid at the moment it is set. When set without liquid, the stage will be set to 0.
